items.name: header-content-footer
items.title: Header / Content / Footer
items.description: The page chassis: chrome that stays, a body that scrolls, floors that let it. Ships the sticky preset alongside the base.

items.name: card-layout
items.title: Card Layout
items.description: A card with its slots already placed: icon, title, description, header action, body, and a footer split between prose and buttons.

items.name: dialog-layout
items.title: Dialog Layout
items.description: A dialog whose body scrolls under a header that does not, and which asks before closing on unsaved work. Composes the header/content/footer chassis rather than owning a second copy.

items.name: page-header
items.title: Page Header
items.description: The title block a page wears in a header slot: an optional trail, an icon and title at a chosen heading level, a description, the page's buttons at the far end, and a search or filter row beneath. Carries the inset the page chassis leaves it.

items.name: split-layout
items.title: Split Layout
items.description: Two panes side by side on a named width scale, with the floors that keep one wide child from pushing the other off the screen. Ships SidebarLayout, the preset for the common case where one pane is the screen and the other is beside it.

items.name: page-layout
items.title: Page Layout
items.description: A whole page: a PageHeader pinned above a body that scrolls under it, in a named column.

items.name: section
items.title: Section
items.description: A heading over a group of fields or rows: title, description, an action at the far end, and an optional rule. An h2, so a long settings page is navigable.

items.name: query-state
items.title: Query State
items.description: The three rungs a list page climbs before it draws a row: the request failed, it has not landed, it landed empty. Ships QueryError and RowSkeleton, the two of them that are worth having on their own.

items.name: disclosure-row
items.title: Disclosure Row
items.description: A list row that opens: the whole heading is the button, the actions sit outside it, and the body is Item's footer. Built on the same Item every other row in the list is.

items.name: form-field
items.title: Form Field
items.description: One field: a label wired to its control, a description that sits inline or behind a help icon, an error the control is described by, and a skeleton the right height for what is loading. Presentational, so the TanStack binding sits on it rather than beside it.

items.name: field-row
items.title: Field Row
items.description: Fields side by side on one row, wrapping when they no longer fit rather than squeezing to a width the values no longer read at.

items.name: app-form
items.title: App Form
items.description: The TanStack Form binding: useAppForm, plus one-element fields — InputField, TextareaField, SelectField, CheckboxField, SwitchField — that take the form and a checked field name instead of a render prop, and SubmitButton.

items.name: multi-select-field
items.title: Multi Select Field
items.description: The multi-select as one line of a form, over a field the compiler checked holds a list of strings.

items.name: date-field
items.title: Date Field
items.description: A date and a date range as one line each, over fields the compiler checked hold a Date and a DateRange.

items.name: color-field
items.title: Color Field
items.description: A colour picker as one line, over a field the compiler checked holds a string.

items.name: radio-group-field
items.title: Radio Group Field
items.description: A set of exclusive choices with the options on the page, each able to carry a line saying what it means. The field that made FormField able to name a group.

items.name: password-field
items.title: Password Field
items.description: A password as one line, with a reveal button none of the nine hand-written password inputs has.

items.name: action-button
items.title: Action Button
items.description: An icon button with a required accessible name, and a tooltip that survives being disabled.

items.name: confirm-button
items.title: Confirm Button
items.description: A destructive button that asks first, with a required description of what is lost.

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: A select taking its choices as options rather than seven primitives to assemble, with groups and separators, and the id and aria props landing on the trigger where Radix needs them.

items.name: multi-select
items.title: Multi Select
items.description: A combobox that selects more than one thing: portalled, keyboard-operable, searchable on every word, with an optional create row and coloured chips.

items.name: date-picker
items.title: Date Picker
items.description: A date and optionally a time behind a popover, plus a range picker that closes when the range is complete. Clearing is a real button, not one nested in another.

items.name: color-picker
items.title: Color Picker
items.description: A colour from a palette, the OS picker or a hex box, with the tick on the chosen swatch drawn in an ink that can be read on it.

items.name: password-input
items.title: Password Input
items.description: A password box with a reveal button that is named, changes its name, and does not submit the form.

items.name: readable-text-color
items.title: Readable Text Color
items.description: Black or white ink for text on a colour the user picked, whichever has more WCAG contrast. Returns nothing it cannot parse, so a caller falls back rather than guessing.

items.name: empty
items.title: Empty
items.description: shadcn's empty state, re-published from here so the voice every project uses for "there is nothing yet" is edited in one place.

items.name: item
items.title: Item
items.description: shadcn's list row, re-published from here so the row shared by every list in every project is edited in one place.

items.name: layout
items.title: Layout Set
items.description: Every cubeui layout shell in one install.

items.name: form
items.title: Form Set
items.description: Every cubeui form component in one install, TanStack binding included.

items.name: control
items.title: Control Set
items.description: Every cubeui control in one install.

items.name: skill
items.title: cubeui Agent Skill
items.description: How to use these components, for agents working in a consuming project. Installs into .claude/skills/ as a router plus layout, form and control references.

items.name: primitive
items.title: Vendored Primitives
items.description: The shadcn primitives cubeui re-publishes unchanged, so a change made here reaches every project.
